new_page.title: Schools in Chilliwack, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 41 public and independent schools with a Chilliwack address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care l

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 41 schools with a Chilliwack street address: 33 public schools and 8 independent schools. It also shows 2 college and university campuses. In that list, 4 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone, 1 alternate program and 1 online school.

Public schools here are run by School District 33 (Chilliwack) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 33 (Chilliwack): 32, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Chilliwack list splits as Chilliwack (39), Cultus Lake (1) and Rosedale (1).
Public secondary schools with a Chilliwack address: Chilliwack Secondary, GW Graham Secondary, Imagine High Integrated Arts/Technology, Kw'íyeqel Secondary and Sardis Secondary.
The Ministry file marks these Chilliwack schools as offering French Immersion: Cheam Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, Sardis Secondary and Vedder Middle School.

Independent schools listed for Chilliwack include Cascade Christian School, Chilliwack Adventist Christian School, Highroad Academy, John Calvin School, Mount Cheam Christian School and St Mary's and 2 more.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
Cultus Lake and Rosedale carry their own mailing communities but sit in the Chilliwack school district, so they are listed here.

faq.q: How many schools are in Chilliwack, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 41 schools with a Chilliwack street address: 33 public schools and 8 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Chilliwack address are run by School District 33 (Chilliwack) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Chilliwack address?
faq.a: Ask School District 33 (Chilliwack) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) to confirm it for the exact street address.
